source_units.text: A drama workshop will use neutral masks.
I would like a study-and-practice schedule for the preparatory concepts.
Even if a day has several short sessions, their combined length must stay within 55 minutes.
Cover these exact topic labels: "Mask Focus", "Neutral Mask Posture", "Gesture Economy".
Give each one at least 20 minutes over the whole plan.
Finish all scheduled study no later than 2027-02-04, inclusive.
